title: Dealer Compliance Memo — Documentation Fee Base for Out-of-State Registrations on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, the documentation fee is built on a documentation fee base, and the table state for that base follows the order's title service — the service type of the order's Title & Registration Services order.

| Title & Registration Services order | Documentation fee base |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | the higher of the selling state's and the registration state's table fees |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | the registration state's table fee |
| any other service | the selling state's table fee |

*Selling state*: the state of the selling Kestrel dealer license (the hub holding the vehicle). *Registration state*: the state of the buyer's residential address, recorded on the order.

**Table fees by state.** AZ $499.00; TX $225.00; GA $599.00; FL $999.00; NC $699.00; OH $387.00; PA $477.00; CO $699.00.

**Worked comparisons (hypothetical orders).**

| Selling state | Registration state | Title service | Base |
|---|---|---|---|
| TX | FL | Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | $999.00 (higher of $225.00 and $999.00) |
| FL | TX | Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | $999.00 (higher of $999.00 and $225.00) |
| FL | TX | Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | $225.00 |
| NC | CO | Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | $699.00 (the two fees are equal) |
| GA | PA | Kestrel In-State New Registration | $599.00 |
| AZ | OH | Kestrel Title-Only Service | $499.00 |
